## 1. Introduction

This report explores the downloaded dataset to understand its structure, variables, completeness and basic characteristics.

## 2. Load the Dataset

```{r}
library(readr)
library(here)
library(knitr)

data <- read_csv(
  here("..", "downloads", "data2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

head(data)
```

## 3. Dataset Overview

```{r}
overview <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Observations",
    "Total Variables",
    "Missing Values",
    "Duplicate Rows"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(data),
    ncol(data),
    sum(is.na(data)),
    sum(duplicated(data))
  )
)

kable(overview, caption = "Dataset Summary")
```

## 4. Data Preview

```{r}
kable(head(data, 10), caption = "First 10 Records")
```

## 5. Variable Information

```{r}
variables <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(data),
  Data_Type = sapply(data, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  Missing = colSums(is.na(data)),
  Missing_Percentage = round(
    colMeans(is.na(data)) * 100, 2
  )
)

kable(variables, caption = "Variable Overview")
```

## 6. Numerical Summary

```{r}
numeric_data <- data[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

if (ncol(numeric_data) > 0) {
  kable(
    as.data.frame(summary(numeric_data)),
    caption = "Descriptive Statistics"
  )
} else {
  cat("No numerical variables available.")
}
```

## 7. Initial Findings

The dataset has been loaded and inspected. The summary tables provide an initial understanding of its dimensions, variable types, missing observations and numerical characteristics.

Further data cleaning and quality assessment can be conducted based on these findings.

## New Plot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = year, y = prevalence, colour = condition)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~database) +
  labs(y = "Prevalence (%)")
```

## Box plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(
  x = year,
  y = prevalence,
  colour = database,
  group = database
)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~condition, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(data$year))) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Trends in Disease Prevalence",
    subtitle = "Comparison of prevalence across databases, 2019–2023",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Prevalence (%)",
    colour = "Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Disease prevalence heatmap
```{r}
latest_data <- subset(
  data,
  year == max(data$year)
)

ggplot(latest_data, aes(
  x = prevalence,
  y = reorder(condition, prevalence),
  colour = database
)) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Latest Disease Prevalence by Database",
    subtitle = "Comparison using the most recent available year",
    x = "Prevalence (%)",
    y = "Condition",
    colour = "Database"
  ) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## year wise Prevalance
```{r}
change_data <- aggregate(
  prevalence ~ database + condition + year,
  data = data,
  FUN = mean
)

start_data <- subset(change_data, year == min(year))
end_data <- subset(change_data, year == max(year))

change_data <- merge(
  start_data[, c("database", "condition", "prevalence")],
  end_data[, c("database", "condition", "prevalence")],
  by = c("database", "condition"),
  suffixes = c("_start", "_end")
)

change_data$change <- change_data$prevalence_end -
                      change_data$prevalence_start

ggplot(change_data, aes(
  x = change,
  y = condition,
  fill = database
)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Disease Prevalence (2019–2023)",
    subtitle = "Absolute change in prevalence, expressed in percentage points",
    x = "Change in prevalence (percentage points)",
    y = "Condition",
    fill = "Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
